title: The Six Bowls
text: Six bowls of beaten bronze sit on six pillars, one for each god the shrine was built for. Five are full of clear water. The sixth is dry and cracked, its bottom furred with dust. The monks will not say why.

options.label: Fill the dry bowl so the forgotten god may drink again.

outcomes.text: The water shines for a moment. Someone, long ago, is grateful.
It was dry for a reason.

options.label: The most devout drinks from all five full bowls, trusting the gods to share.

outcomes.text: None of the five gods minds.
One of the five minds very much.

options.label: Leave the bowls as they are; whatever the monks will not say is not your concern.

outcomes.text: The water does not ripple as you pass. The god of the dry bowl marks that you left it empty.

options.label: The Soothsayer fills the dry bowl from their own flask, as the cards have told them to.

outcomes.text: The sixth god drinks. For a long time after, the Soothsayer's cards stay warm in their pocket.
